title: Building NOISEEDGE — an AI-powered tool to make crypto trading decisions a little less noisy
author: NoiseEdge
selftext:
We've been working on a side project called NOISEEDGE, and we wanted to share it here and get some honest feedback.

The idea came from a problem we find interesting: crypto markets move fast, there's a lot of information to process, and it can be difficult to turn charts and indicators into a clear trading plan.

So we're building a platform designed to bring some of those tools together:

* 📊 Market charts and technical indicators
* 🤖 An AI assistant that helps explain market conditions and indicator signals
* 🧪 Strategy backtesting to test ideas against historical data
* 🎮 Paper trading and trading competitions, so users can practise without risking real money

Our goal isn't to promise profitable trades or predict every market move. We want to help people analyse, test and learn before making their own decisions.

We're still developing the project, so there's a lot to figure out — especially how to make the experience genuinely useful rather than just adding AI for the sake of it.

We'd love to hear from other builders and traders here:

**What would make a tool like this genuinely useful to you?** Is it better backtesting, clearer explanations of indicators, paper trading, or something else entirely?

Any honest feedback is welcome!
